video.title: AI欧腐《挣脱：离开教父/Untethered: Leaving the Don》
video.desc:
看不看都行 但我没想到这逆天剧本也给教父安排上了

Russo underboss Luca and don Damian, lovers, built an empire with black crown tattoos. Finding Damian's affair with Camila (tattoo, blood oath), he shifts assets, flees. Damian takes a birthday bullet for him, yet Luca hears "forget him" to Camila. Framed for Camila's kidnapping, he's sacked, drowned, whipped—14 years to ash.

Russo 家族的二把手 Luca 与教父 Damian 是一对恋人，两人以黑色王冠纹身为誓，共同打下了一个帝国。发现 Damian 与 Camila 有染（同样的纹身，同样的血誓）之后，他转移资产，准备逃离。生日那天，Damian 替他挡下一颗子弹，可 Luca 却听见他对 Camila 说"忘了他吧"。随后他被诬陷绑架 Camila，被装进麻袋、沉入水中、遭受鞭打，十四年的感情就此化为灰烬。
